about: A tool that automatically removes the built-in refusals from AI language models.

prs.title: Square brackets in AI text no longer crash the run
prs.broken: With the option to print prompts and the AI's replies turned on, text with square brackets, like [/INST], crashed the program, and other bracketed words vanished from the output.
prs.changed: I made the printing treat brackets as plain text, not as formatting codes.
prs.matters: Runs finish, and the printed text shows exactly what the prompt and the AI said.
